issues.desc: background.md Key Insights describes B-e74e as being about availability rather than unrelated-dirty contention, but code comments in done-effects.ts (line 330, 460) show B-e74e CHK-001 introduced the broad main-worktree clean check itself. The distinction is functional but the characterization slightly understates B-e74e scope; a reader could be misled about what B-e74e did vs what this story changes.
